whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Syzygium,

I noticed your establishment has strong 4.4★ reviews across 340+ customer ratings on Fraser Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile-optimized web page for local inquiries.

Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table/service booking, premium gallery, aur location integration hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/syzygium

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Syzygium, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Syzygium on Fraser Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, gorgeous imagery showcase, and direct WhatsApp inquiry buttons for your customers in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
